_comment: SOLE signer-verifier allowlist for the C2 scheduler-lease-context issuer's OWN Ed25519 signing key (Foundation C, C2-SCI design rev4, C2-SCHEDULER-CONTEXT-ISSUER-DESIGN-20260806.md §2). Public-only; NO private material. A DISTINCT key family from config/aqos/lease-signer-keys.json (the C2 admission-lease signer) — this file verifies the aq.scheduler-lease-context/1 documents minted by the confined aq-c2-scheduler-context-issuer service, never the presented lease itself. dispatch.py's B3 ingress adapter verifies a context's signature ONLY through this status-bearing allowlist via capability_lease.verify_authoritative(); a key_id absent here, or present with status != "active", denies at verify time (re-checked every call) — a revoked key never verifies. B2 (this file): PLACEHOLDER public key only, no paired private key exists yet. Activation (a later, separately-reviewed owner act) provisions the real SOPS private key at /run/secrets/c6-scheduler-context-signing-key and replaces this placeholder public key with its true pair.
